title: Zesty Middle Eastern Chicken Tagine
description: A cultured and creamy Middle Eastern dish featuring saffron and perfect for a date night, this recipe is low in fat and full of flavor. It is a delicious and exotic meal that will transport your taste buds to the Middle East.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, saffron threads, and dried dates, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes.
Stir in the Greek yogurt and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
